At p=263681 the integer squared positivity difference is 65536, and the bound increases thereafter. Independently wrote and compiled a distinct C++17 sieve/primitive-root bitmap verifier, exhaustively checking all 11538 eligible primes below 263681: exactly 144 have incomplete coverage; last is 3361 with sole missing code 195=(3,0,0,3), next eligible 3373 complete; zero-word last absent at 2689. Thus a justified finite exhaustion joins the infinite proof, not sampled extrapolation.
